widgets_values: Describe product details such as style, material and pattern.

The product is a pair of casual sneakers. They feature a denim-like material with a blue and white color scheme. The sneakers have white laces and a white rubber sole. The design includes a wavy white stripe on the side, adding a stylish touch. The overall look is casual and comfortable, suitable for everyday wear.
